from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanySharesData(BaseModel):
    """One company's shares outstanding data from its financial filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    metric_type: str | None = Field(description="What the metric represents (e.g., 'shares of common stock', 'units of beneficial interest')")
    shares_outstanding: int | None = Field(description="The total number of shares/units outstanding as reported")
    as_of_date: str | None = Field(description="The date as of which this share count is valid")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the share count disclosure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_shares_data: list[CompanySharesData]
